memoryEstimate.note: Analytic lower bound for main MSAA/depth/HDR/bloom/cloud render targets only. Excludes simulation, driver alignment, browser compositor, and transient resources.

continuousSpectrum.model: JONSWAP / Elfouhaily hybrid; normalized band-limited swell

spectral.observationalStatus: UNVERIFIED: one realization, linear slopes; Cox-Munk uses U12.5, not U10; no ensemble confidence interval.
spectral.whitecapStatus: UNVERIFIED: no long-duration, area-weighted coverage observation.
spectral.tolerance: Parseval <0.0015 includes binary16 storage; conjugate coefficients <1e-7. Zero NaN/Inf in sampled fields.

foam.interpretation: Simulation-memory density over uniform parameter-space texels, not observed projected optical whitecap coverage. A single instant cannot validate a wind-coverage fit.
